description: The current state of one if-so payment, read from the chain: status (OPEN, MET, RELEASED, RETURNED, VOIDED, CANCELLED), amount in USDG, sender, recipient or claim link key, expiry and the condition that unlocks it. Payment ids are large whole numbers (up to 78 digits); pass them as a string.

id.description: The payment id as a decimal string, e.g. "12" or a 78-digit id.

name: ifso_get_payment
title: IFSO payment status
